name: Residential Fellowships at the Center for Advanced Internet Studies (CAIS)
summary: Are you researching the social effects of digitalisation? Do you want more freedom for your project and are interested in interdisciplinary exchange? A fellowship at CAIS releases you from your regular work obligations and offers many
